{"results":[{"doc_id":"kb-deposit-rules","title":"Kaveri Bank (fictional): fixed deposit rules, premature withdrawal and loans against deposits","date":"2026-11-01","section":"Closing a fixed deposit (FD) early: premature withdrawal","passage":"Closing a fixed deposit (FD) early: premature withdrawal
A Kaveri Bank fixed deposit can be closed before it matures. Interest is then paid at the rate on the bank's rate card, on the date of the deposit, for the period the deposit actually ran, less a penalty of 1.00 percentage point (0.50 percentage point for senior citizens). Interest already credited at a higher rate is recovered from the payout. A deposit closed within 7 days earns no interest.

Example: a deposit opened for 3 years and closed after 1 year earns the rate for "1 year to less than 2 years" that applied when it was opened, less the penalty."},{"doc_id":"kb-deposit-rates","title":"Kaveri Bank (fictional): deposit rate card, fixed and recurring deposits","date":"2026-11-01","section":"How fixed deposit (FD) interest is paid","passage":"How fixed deposit (FD) interest is paid
On a cumulative fixed deposit, interest compounds quarterly and is paid with the principal at maturity. A senior citizen is a depositor aged 60 or over on the date of the deposit. The rate is fixed on the date of the deposit for its whole tenure."},{"doc_id":"kb-charges","title":"Kaveri Bank (fictional): schedule of charges for loans and cards","date":"2026-11-01","section":"Credit card charges","passage":"Credit card charges
A late payment fee is charged when the minimum amount due is not paid by the due date. It depends on the total amount due on the statement:

| Total amount due | Late payment fee |
| --- | --- |
| Up to ₹500 | Nil |
| ₹501 to ₹5,000 | ₹525 |
| ₹5,001 to ₹10,000 | ₹775 |
| ₹10,001 to ₹25,000 | ₹975 |
| ₹25,001 to ₹50,000 | ₹1,150 |
| Above ₹50,000 | ₹1,375 |

Cash withdrawal on a credit card: 2.50% of the amount, at least ₹500. Foreign currency transactions: a mark-up of 3.25%."}]}
